messages.text:
"I want a 8-bit game that slowly evolves into a 3d 3rd person shooter. It would start off about a mad scientist who wants to devolve the world so he can become supreme ruler of graphics. Sprinkled lore everywhere til you come to him in the final battle which would be like a bullet hell. But before you get to the final boss, we need atleast 3-4 hours of gameplay where we slowly evolve to overcome the mad scientist scheme. It would start out with a rpg, turn based combat, wayyy before we get into the bullet hellscape that awaits you at the mad scientists domain.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
